squares.label: "Lights out and away!"
squares.description: Crofty calls the start with the line he has never once skipped.

squares.label: Safety car deployed
squares.description: The safety car is sent out, full or virtual.

squares.label: Red flag
squares.description: The race is stopped and the field is sent to the pit lane.

squares.label: Rain starts falling
squares.description: Rain reaches the circuit during the race, wherever on the track.

squares.label: A lap time is deleted
squares.description: A lap time is deleted for exceeding track limits.
